name: Michael Chandler

face.shape: Broad, square-rectangular face with a wide, strong jaw and high, prominent cheekbones; the head is broad for his short stature.
face.jaw: Wide, square and strongly angled with heavy masseters; visible under short stubble.
face.chin: Broad, square, moderately prominent, average height; no cleft visible.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent; the face narrows slightly below them; cheeks lean.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate to strong, brows set low on it.
face.forehead: Broad and fairly high, made higher by deep recession at both temples (M-shaped hairline) with a strong central forelock.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow with heavy upper lids; outer corners level to slightly downturned. Strong crow's feet when he smiles.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Medium-dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and mostly straight with a slight lift through the middle, tails tapering.

nose.width: Broad at the base, wide nostrils.
nose.bridge: Medium width, straight in the front view.
nose.hump: Mild bump on the upper bridge in the 2023 near-profile.
nose.tip: Broad, rounded and projecting; nostrils clearly visible from below.
nose.fight_damage: Tip and lower nose look thickened/broadened; no strong sideways deviation.

face.mouth: Medium width, medium lips with a thinner upper lip; wide smile showing the upper teeth, deep smile lines.

ears.cauliflower: Yes, both ears: thickened helix and folded, lumpy antihelix, clear on the right ear (2023) and the left ear (walkout photo). They protrude moderately.

face.notable_marks_scars: Diagonal scar about 3 cm long on his left cheek, running down and outward from below the outer corner of the eye (visible in the UFC studio headshot). Crow's feet and forehead lines when smiling.

hair.style: Short sides and back faded close (clipper fade), with 4-6 cm on top, textured and pushed up and back into a short quiff; in 2021 it was spiked up. Consistent 2021-2026.
hair.colour_samples_note: The 2023 sample has a cool/blue cast from the event lighting.
hair.hairline: Strong M: deep recession at both temples, especially visible from the side; dense forelock and top.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with a few grey hairs on the chin.
facial_hair.colour_samples_note: The studio chin sample mixes stubble and skin; the 2023 jaw sample is closer to the strand colour.
facial_hair.density: Medium-dense on the moustache, chin and jaw; lighter on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 2-5 mm: heavy stubble rather than a beard (about 2-3 mm in the 2023 near-profile, 3-5 mm in the studio headshot and walkout photo).
facial_hair.shape: Even heavy stubble following the jaw with a slightly denser connected moustache; low natural cheek line, neckline under the jaw.

tone_samples.light: indoor event light, slightly cool/pink white balance
indoor event light, slightly cool/pink white balance

skin.body_note: Studio abdomen sample is darker and more tanned than the face (shadows between the abs pull it down).
skin.freckles_marks: Cheek scar (see face). Moderate dark chest hair, light forearm hair.
skin.texture_pick: middleage_caucasian_male tinted warmer and slightly olive toward tone_hex.

body.build: Short, compact and very muscular "power" physique: thick chest, shoulders, arms and legs; the most muscular of these four.
body.body_fat_notes: Deep, sharply cut abs and visible obliques in both studio stance photos (one from June 2026) and at the June 2026 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Broad, with big rounded deltoids and thick traps.
body.chest: Thick, full pectorals with moderate dark chest hair.
body.arms: Very muscular, short-to-average length, vascular forearms.
body.waist: Narrow relative to the chest; clear V-taper.
body.legs: Very muscular thighs and big calves.
body.notable_physique_traits: Wrestler's thick neck and dense upper back; short limbs relative to the torso.

tattoos.where: Left upper chest, below the collarbone
tattoos.size: About 10-12 cm wide x 4 cm tall

tattoos.description: About eight lines of small black block text, stacked horizontally (text not legible)
tattoos.size: About 10 cm wide x 9 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right inner forearm, just below the elbow
Left inner forearm, just below the elbow
tattoos.description: Small black letters (partly seen as "AP"), vertical

tattoos.where: Back of the left shoulder, upper shoulder blade

accessories_seen: Dark wristwatch and a black ring in daily wear; tinted round glasses and a double-breasted black suit at the June 2026 press event; US flag at walkouts.

kit.typical_shorts: Patriotic red Venum shorts with navy stars and navy diagonal stripes (June 2026 studio, with blue "Freedom 250" gloves); red shorts with white stripes at UFC Freedom 250 under a white-and-blue striped walkout jersey; black UFC shorts with a tonal dark-grey star print and crypto.com logo (earlier studio).
kit.gloves: Standard UFC 4 oz gloves; blue Freedom 250 gloves in June 2026.

render_hints.hair: short proxy (short02 or short04) tinted #352a26, with the temples pulled back to show the M-shaped recession
render_hints.scar: optional thin pale line on the left cheek below the outer eye

notes: Confidence: high for hair, build, tattoos, skin and overall face shape; medium for nose and eye detail; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 13 photos (6 Commons CC BY/CC BY-SA/PD, 7 reference-only incl. one Commons file with a doubtful own-work claim), 5 from 2026 (two public-domain government photos from UFC Freedom 250 week). Good near-profile: Gage Skidmore 2023 (right side, laughing). What to watch: (1) the square, wide jaw and high cheekbones; (2) M-shaped receding hairline with a short dark quiff; (3) very muscular, compact body, much more muscle than the other three; (4) broad nose tip and cauliflower ears; (5) the "Blessed" chest script and rib text are the visible tattoos.

changes: Re-checked every photo; hair and M-shaped hairline, cauliflower ears, left-cheek scar, tattoos (Blessed, rib text, ACE/AP forearms, left-shoulder character), build, kit and skin samples are supported.
Facial hair changed from "short beard" to heavy stubble (2-5 mm); no photo shows a beard longer than about 5 mm.
All six Commons embed-ok licences confirmed on Commons (2 PD US government, 2 CC BY-SA 2.0, 1 CC BY 2.0, 1 reviewed CC BY 3.0).
Morph names all exist in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json; all values are within 0..1.
